scope: Atomic source-request admission shared by authorization, repository-authority pagination and observations.
behavior: Every credential-bearing transport call requires a SourceRequestGuard.
The session/connection/generation check and HttpClient request initiation share the same lock used by disconnect/replacement.
Invalidation cancels the prior connection source I/O; an invalidated scope cannot initiate later requests.
